title: Runway Clearance Mutual-Exclusion Interlock
required_invariants: visibility_m < 0 or crosswind_kt < 0 or blank flight_id must raise ValueError.
If runway_occupied is True, clearance must be 'hold_short' regardless of weather (unless emergency_override is True -> 'emergency_supervisor_review').
If visibility_m < 550 or crosswind_kt > 30, return 'hold_short' (or 'emergency_supervisor_review' if emergency_override).
